laws.title: Laws
laws.description: Laws to sync: a BOE id (BOE-A-2015-11430), any boe.es URL that contains one, or an alias such as estatuto-trabajadores, codigo-civil, codigo-penal, constitucion, irpf, iva, lopdgdd (full list in the README).

asOfDate.title: As of date
asOfDate.description: Return the text in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to follow the law as it changes (today in Spain). A fixed date keeps its own sync state, so a one-off run at a past date never disturbs the store you keep up to date.

maxChunkChars.title: Max chunk size (characters)
maxChunkChars.description: Articles longer than this are split by paragraphs, then by sentences. About 4 characters per token.

syncId.title: Sync ID
syncId.description: Turns on incremental sync: the Actor remembers what it sent under this name and the next run emits only what changed, plus deletes. Required for scheduled runs; use one per vector store. Leave empty for a one-off export of every chunk, with no state kept.

fullReload.title: Full reload
fullReload.description: With a syncId: emit every chunk again (and delete stale ones), e.g. after wiping your vector store. Without a syncId every run already emits everything.
